narrative.text: Merchant MID100094 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 412 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are velocity_drift at +12.0 sigma (observed 1.55 against a category baseline of -0.00183), velocity_recent at +11.4 sigma (observed 3.59 against a category baseline of 1.65), round_share_drift at +10.8 sigma (observed 0.219 against a category baseline of 0.00022). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
